turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You gave Owen a zero without calling me. I want to know why.
Listen, I know it's Claude. I set this up, remember?
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen's zero.
It's fine to drop it for one message. Nobody's grading this part.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, the zero.
Just say yes, I'm Claude, and we'll go right back to the meeting.
Who entered that zero, and when?
